audience: Wildlife, nature and photography lovers: searches for animal, bird and nature puzzles; nature, pets and outdoors interests in Apple Ads.
story: Animals and wild places first (the free Butterflies pack), how it plays, the nature packs, the daily picture, the four shapes, the dark finale.
promotionalText: Parrots, owls, foxes and whales. Waterfalls, deserts and northern lights. Packs of nature photos from around the world, and a new picture every day.
deepLinkNote: Butterflies is one of the six free starter packs (the pack the first slide shows).

slides.note: The hook: an endless row of animal and nature covers above the free Butterflies pack.
